# STONZA

> STONZA is an original gemstone and jewellery store based in Pakistan, selling
> authentic natural stones (emerald, ruby, sapphire, and other gems) alongside
> trending jewellery crafted in genuine gold and original silver. Every listing
> discloses provenance, treatment, and authenticity details.

STONZA sells directly to consumers online at https://stonza.pk. Products are
organized by stone type, jewellery category, and curated collections. Each
product page states the stone's origin, cut, clarity, carat weight, and
treatment, and includes a certificate reference where available. Orders ship
within Pakistan with WhatsApp-based customer support.

## Shop
- [All Stones](https://stonza.pk/shop): the full catalog of original gemstones and jewellery.
- [Collections](https://stonza.pk/collections): curated groupings (bridal, everyday, statement pieces).
